pages.title: Tumble Dungeon: Gravity Puzzle
pages.creator: Aiwa Int
pages.description: Rotate the entire dungeon in Tumble Dungeon: Gravity Puzzle. Your hero can walk left or right, but a turn of the room sends them falling in the new direction until a wall stops them. Recover missing gears, repair the mechanisms, and activate the portal. Plan where you'll land before rotating past spikes, holes, and roaming monsters.

pages.title: ArrowXis Brain Escape Puzzle
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description: Look for a piece with a free tail in ArrowXis Brain Escape Puzzle and tap it to remove it. Depending on the mode, that move may also clear pieces linked by color or direction, or remove other pieces that are free. Plan a sequence that leaves you a way to clear the entire layout.

pages.title: Jewel Toy Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match groups of at least three identical toys in Jewel Toy Puzzle. Work out which combinations will clear the board the way you need, then use boosters to get through tricky layouts. Complete tasks and special events as you play to earn rewards for your progress.

pages.title: Sorting Games Toy Sort
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Find sets of three matching toys in Sorting Games Toy Sort. Move toys around to bring matching dolls together as the timer runs down. Look for a move that frees up space for the next set, and rethink your order as the shelves take on new layouts.

pages.title: Mine&Build
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Explore a planet and gather the materials to leave it in Mine&Build. Move with WASD and approach deposits to mine them automatically. Use what you collect to craft useful structures and work toward a flying platform that can carry you off the planet.

pages.title: Tiny Golf King
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Line up shots on miniature golf courses in Tiny Golf King. Look at the shape of each hole and where the cup sits before using the mouse or touch to play your shot. There are more than 45 levels to work through.

pages.title: Geometry Missile
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Steer a triangular missile through Geometry Missile as it flies forward on its own. Tap to guide it vertically through gaps between rectangles, triangles, and spikes. Watch how much room you have to change height, then line up with the gate at the end of the stage.

pages.title: PoppyTile
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Match sets of three tiles in PoppyTile. Tap tiles with the same picture to clear them, then look for the next set among the tiles that remain. Work through the whole layout against a farm backdrop, keeping track of which pictures you still need.

pages.title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Tap to send your ball higher in Ball Jump Switch The Colors. Check the ball's current color against the section of obstacle overhead. It can pass through a matching section, or you can guide it through a gap. Wait for a safe opening before bouncing into the next barrier.

pages.title: Spooky Chains
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Drag through three or more matching Halloween items in Spooky Chains. Each chain clears those items and turns the tiles underneath gold. Aim your next chain at parts of the board that still need to change color. A level is complete when the whole board is golden.

pages.title: Candy Monster Raffi
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Get Raffi to the candy in Candy Monster Raffi. Pick a direction for each jump, checking where he'll land before sending him across the level. Spikes can end the attempt, so plan a path that reaches the sweets without dropping the hungry monster onto a hazard.

pages.title: Bone Doctor Shoulder Case
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help an injured cheerleader in Bone Doctor Shoulder Case. Follow the on-screen steps to treat her shoulder, then move on to the makeover once the procedure is complete. Pick clothes and accessories to get her ready to return to the cheer squad.

pages.title: Stickman vs Zombies WorldCraft
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hunt down craft zombies as a stick ninja in Stickman vs Zombies WorldCraft. Move through the platforms looking for enemies before they rush you or open fire. Clear out every zombie in the area and collect the money you find along the way to unlock more skins.

pages.title: Mental Hospital Escape
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Play either side of a timed chase in Mental Hospital Escape. As the doctor, look for the patients and catch them before time expires. As a patient, climb over rocks and find ways around the doctor to stay free until the round is over.

pages.title: Merge Master Skibidi Bop
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Combine monsters to evolve your army in Merge Master Skibidi Bop. Decide which creatures to merge before sending them into battle against Skibidi Toilet. Each evolution changes the forces you can field, so build up the lineup and see how it holds up in the next fight.

pages.title: Halloween Tiles Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear the board in Halloween Tiles Mahjong by sending tiles into a stack that holds up to nine. Three identical tiles disappear once they're in the stack. Choose tiles with a match in mind and leave enough room to finish a set before every slot fills.

pages.title: Steve and Alex Skibidi Toilet
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Keep Steve and Alex moving ahead of the Skibidi Toilet monster. Collect emeralds during the chase and spend them on costumes. Decide which pickups you can reach without letting the monster close the gap, since getting caught ends the escape.

pages.title: Island.io
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Send ships to capture opposing islands in Island.io. Conquer territory to earn gold, then use it to improve your island, buy ships, or speed up training. As your fleet grows, choose the next island to take and work toward collecting the available monuments and colors.

pages.title: Dress Up Games & Coloring Book
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Design a doll and turn the result into a picture in Dress Up Games & Coloring Book. Pick a hairstyle, makeup, clothes, and accessories, then set the doll against a background. Color the finished scene with patterns, gradients, or glitter, changing details as you go to make your own wallpaper.

pages.title: Real Drift Multiplayer
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Choose one of three cars and take it drifting in Real Drift Multiplayer. Practice on your own or go online to drift with other drivers. Try a different car to get a feel for its handling, then work on keeping the car in a slide through the turns.

pages.title: Helicopter Assassin
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Carry out missions from a helicopter in Helicopter Assassin. Take aim at the assigned targets as the aircraft moves and finish the job to earn money. Spend the payout on different weapons before heading back out for the next assignment.

pages.title: Animal Run
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Run as a lion, cat, cow, or another animal in Animal Run. Keep an eye on the route and get out of the way of obstacles as they come up at speed. Make it through the course to reach new levels with more stretches of track to negotiate.

pages.title: Robot Ring Fighting
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Take a robot into the wrestling ring in Robot Ring Fighting. Throw punches and chain attacks together to beat the robot across from you. Wins earn rewards you can spend on new fighters, giving you more options when you head back into the ring.

pages.title: Truck Space
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Maneuver a large truck into the marked bay in Truck Space. Watch how much room you have to turn and line up the vehicle before pulling into place. Finish quickly to earn a higher score and work toward unlocking the driving achievements.

pages.title: Mr Noob Fighter
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: Fight enemies and keep moving past obstacles in Mr Noob Fighter. Move with S, strike with A, and defend with D. Time your jumps as you cross the course, and pick up coins to unlock another look for Mr Noob.

pages.title: Arrow Count Master
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build up a group of arrows in Arrow Count Master. Guide them through gates with large positive numbers and steer clear of red gates that subtract from the group. The run stops if you run out of arrows. Pick up coins along the way and use them to buy skins.

pages.title: Huggie Wuggie Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fit the pieces together in Huggie Wuggie Jigsaw, starting with the first picture. Solving it earns money you can put toward unlocking the rest of the collection. Each of the ten pictures has three difficulty settings, with the toughest option paying out the most when you finish.

pages.title: Friday Night Funki Noob
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Keep the beat with blocky Minecraft characters in Friday Night Funki Noob. Watch for the cues in each song and press the corresponding button as it comes up. Time your inputs with the music to build up your score, then try another track and learn its rhythm.

pages.title: One Button Speedway
pages.creator: RodaGames
pages.description: Take tight corners on a speedway motorcycle in One Button Speedway. Press to start drifting, hold to tighten the turn, and let go when you need to take a wider line. Watch how quickly the next bend approaches as you build speed along the straight.

pages.title: Kill The Dragon - Bridge Block Puzzle
pages.creator: GameArt
pages.description: Remove blocks to give a knight a safe crossing in Kill The Dragon - Bridge Block Puzzle. Look at how the remaining pieces can form a bridge from one side to the other. Once he can get across, the knight can defeat the dragon and collect the gold coin. There are 50 puzzles to solve.

pages.title: Mandala Coloring Book
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Choose colors for the patterns in Mandala Coloring Book. Fill in parts of the picture one by one, trying out combinations across the repeated shapes. Give neighboring sections contrasting colors or use a shared palette across the whole design to make the mandala your own.

pages.title: Straw Hat Samurai
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Draw sword strokes through enemy soldiers in Straw Hat Samurai. The northern Aka-Ryu army is pushing south, and your forts are under siege. Choose the path of each slash as you move through the battlefield and fight to stop the advance.

pages.title: Korean Supermodel Makeup
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Take the role of a makeup artist and stylist in Korean Supermodel Makeup. Start with the model's look and use makeup and accessories to put your own spin on it. Try different combinations as you decide what suits the style you want to create.

pages.title: Cute Fish Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of fish from scattered jigsaw pieces in Cute Fish Jigsaw. Look for pieces with matching colors, edges, or parts of the same fish, then place them where they fit. Finish one underwater picture and pick another when you want a different set of shapes to sort.

pages.title: Color Ship Shooter
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Match your shots to the color of the objects moving toward your ship in Color Ship Shooter. A number on each target shows how many hits it still needs. Firing the wrong color raises that number, so switch your shots carefully and clear the targets before they reach the ship.

pages.title: Extreme Jelly Shift 3D
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Change the proportions of a moving piece of jelly in Extreme Jelly Shift 3D. Look at the opening ahead and reshape the jelly to fit before it gets there. Keep adjusting as the gaps change from one obstacle to the next so the jelly can slide through without hitting the sides.

pages.title: Santa Gifts Rescue
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Help Santa retrieve his presents in Santa Gifts Rescue. Look at what's held in place by each pin, then decide which one to pull and in what order. Each level changes the arrangement, so think through where the gifts will go before you release them.

pages.title: BTS Funny Frog Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color the frog pictures in BTS Funny Frog Coloring Book. Pick a frog drawing and try different colors on its outlines and details. You can give one frog a rainbow palette and use a completely different set of colors when you move on to another picture.

pages.title: Rainbow Frozen
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Mix a frozen drink in Rainbow Frozen. Pick the flavors and fruit you want to use, then choose how to decorate the glass. Change up the ingredients or presentation to make a different drink and see how the colors look together in the finished glass.

pages.title: Pixel Zombies
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Click or tap the incoming zombies to stop them in Pixel Zombies. Watch for the next one to appear and take it out quickly before it gets too far. Clear the zombies to move through the levels and defend more of the cities under attack.

pages.title: Outfits Woman Rush
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Pick up outfits as you run in Outfits Woman Rush. Keep moving through the course and steer around obstacles that could interrupt your run. Look for gold coins along the way and spend them on new skins so you can change your look between runs.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Photoshoot
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Get Baby Hazel ready for a children's fashion magazine in Baby Hazel Photoshoot. Pick her outfit, add accessories and glittery makeup, then decide how to style her hair. Once she's ready for Uncle Adam's camera, choose props and help her pose for the pictures.

pages.title: Neon Rocket
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Keep a hard-to-steer rocket balanced in Neon Rocket. Correct its flight when it starts drifting toward an obstacle and look for a safe path to the stars. Collect what you can while keeping enough room to adjust the rocket's direction without crashing.

pages.title: Mahjong Candy
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Clear candy tiles in pairs in Mahjong Candy. Scan the board for two of the same candy that you can take, then see what their removal makes available. Work quickly enough to clear the whole layout before time runs out.

pages.title: Police Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Piece together pictures of police cars in Police Cars Jigsaw. Drag each piece into the position where its shape and image fit. Use details from the car to work out which parts go together, then complete the scene as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Digital Vehicles Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Choose one of eight vehicle pictures in Digital Vehicles Jigsaw Puzzle. Drag the pieces into their spots until the image is complete. Start with a 2-by-3 layout or switch to 3-by-4 or 4-by-6 for more pieces and smaller visual clues.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Mothers Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel and her dad plan a surprise in Baby Hazel Mothers Day. Shop for the supplies they need, then go to the kitchen to make a cake. Decorate the room once the baking is done so everything is ready when Hazel's mom joins the celebration.

pages.title: CarWarz.io
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Ram rival cars from behind or from the side in CarWarz.io. Keep moving around the arena so opponents have fewer chances to land a hit. Grab fire for a stronger attack, or pick up a shield or health when you need protection. There are four maps and eighteen cartoon cars in the game.

pages.title: Flag Word Puzz
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Look at the flag and arrange the letters to spell its country's name in Flag Word Puzz. Use details such as the colors or symbols to recognize the flag, then use the letters to check your guess. Work through 28 flags as the names get less familiar.

pages.title: BTS Sweet Kitty Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Give the cat drawings your own palette in BTS Sweet Kitty Coloring. Pick colors and apply them to the Sweet Kitty picture, choosing a look for each part of the scene. Try a different combination whenever you want to give the same subject a new look.

pages.title: Cute Panda Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find matching panda pictures in Cute Panda Memory Challenge. Look closely at the details so you can tell two similar pandas apart. Remember where each picture appeared, then use those positions to make pairs as you work through the board.

pages.title: Cargo Truck Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a cargo truck through a series of driving missions in Cargo Truck Simulator. Use WASD to steer, accelerate, and slow down as you work your way to the marked destination. Give the truck room to turn when you're hauling a load.

pages.title: Christmas Rooms Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Compare two views of a Christmas-decorated room in Christmas Rooms Differences. Look for small changes among the ornaments and furniture, then mark each one when you see it. There are seven differences to find in each room before the timer expires.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Pet Doctor
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel and her cousin Ashley play veterinarian in Baby Hazel Pet Doctor. Dress Hazel for the job, then pick out the tools she'll need. Use the supplies and medicines to care for the pets as the two children work through their checkups and treatments.

pages.title: Space Roll
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Guide a ball across glowing platforms in Space Roll. Steer around obstacles and gaps to stay on the track, and collect gems when you have a safe route to them. Spend the gems on new balls and try to stay on the platform longer in the next run.

pages.title: Car Mechanic 2017
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Work in a repair garage in Car Mechanic 2017. Move around the workshop with WASD and inspect the cars you're assigned. Check what needs attention, then carry out the maintenance and repair tasks as you work through the mechanic's jobs.

pages.title: Anti Stress Game
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose an activity from the menu in Anti Stress Game. Try popping bubbles, drawing on a canvas, or playing with the movable figure. Click or tap to interact, and switch back to the menu whenever you feel like trying a different toy.

pages.title: Angelic Charm Princess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create a bright or dark angel in Angelic Charm Princess. Choose wings, dresses, magical accessories, and weapons to give the princess the look you have in mind. Try soft colors for a dawn-inspired outfit or build a darker combination around the sunset theme.

pages.title: Deep Worm
pages.creator: Isaske Games
pages.description: Burrow beneath the desert in Deep Worm, then burst up to attack soldiers and military vehicles. Steer with A and D and use Space for a burst of speed. Dive below the surface again as the military fires back, and see how long the worm can survive.

pages.title: Reflector PGS
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Guide a laser to its target in Reflector PGS. Drag blocks into place to reflect the beam and think through where it will go after each bounce. There are 40 puzzles, each giving you a different route to work out between the laser and the target.

pages.title: USA Map Challenge
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Place all 50 states on the map in USA Map Challenge. Use the outlines and neighboring states to work out where each one belongs. Try to finish the whole map quickly and see which parts of the country you can place without having to stop and think.

pages.title: Doggy Quest The Dark Forest
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a dog through a forest full of monsters in Doggy Quest The Dark Forest. Flip the dog to switch between the ordinary world and its darker counterpart. Watch the path on both sides and change worlds when it lets you get past a creature safely.

pages.title: Color Shooter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Time your shots in Color Shooter so they can pass through the matching parts of moving obstacles. Wait for a usable opening as the colors shift, then send the shot through. A collision with the wrong color ends the attempt and sends you back to try again.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Plus
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fit colored shapes into a 10-by-10 grid in Block Puzzle Plus. Look for spaces that match each piece and decide where to set it so you can keep placing more. Make complete lines to open up room, and leave some space for shapes that take up several cells.

pages.title: Winter Ski Trip
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Put together cold-weather outfits for the dolls in Winter Ski Trip. Try a different combination on each doll, using the winter wardrobe to give them distinct looks. Compare the finished outfits at the end and decide which one you'd pick for a day out in the snow.

pages.title: Mr Black
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Send a small ninja cube upward in Mr Black. Tap to jump and time each rise through the opening between the spiked platforms. Look ahead at where the next pair of spikes leaves room to pass, then see how high you can climb without hitting one.

pages.title: Pregnant Princesses Catwalk Show
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two expectant princesses for a maternity fashion competition in Pregnant Princesses Catwalk Show. Choose an outfit for each contestant and get them ready to walk the runway. See how the looks compare when the princesses take the stage and one of them wins the show.

pages.title: Mini Drift 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Slide around corners in Mini Drift 2 and try to keep the car on the track. Watch each bend as it comes up so you can set up the next drift in time. Unlock other cars and tracks as you get more comfortable with the turns.

pages.title: Tank Game Online
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Take a tank into battle in Tank Game Online. Defend your area from opposing tanks and look for chances to fire back. Keep track of where the other vehicles are moving so you can stay in the fight and push toward victory.

pages.title: Protect The Kingdom
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build towers along the invaders' route in Protect The Kingdom. Stop wolves, swordsmen, archers, and wizards before they reach the kingdom. Defeated enemies give you energy to spend on more defenses. As new tower types become available, decide where each one can best cover the path.

pages.title: SuperPig Blast
pages.creator: HNGames
pages.description: Fire SuperPig out of a barrel in SuperPig Blast. Wait until the shot lines up with the opening, then launch the pig through it. The gap shrinks as you go, leaving less room for error. String together successful shots and collect apples for new barrels and backgrounds.

pages.title: Basic Snake
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Guide your snake to the dots in Basic Snake. Eating them makes the snake longer, so keep looking for a route with room to move while you grow. Watch for other creatures and steer clear of them as you pick up the next dot.

pages.title: Bride Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Kitty ready for her wedding in Bride Preps. Choose a wedding dress, then pair it with shoes and accessories. Once Kitty is dressed, move out to the garden and decorate the space where her friends will join her for the ceremony.

pages.title: Furious Road
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive through a post-apocalyptic landscape in Furious Road. Use the machine gun and rockets to deal with enemies blocking the road as you make your way home. Upgrade your weapons along the way so you can take on the next stretch with more firepower.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Sauna Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Get Dotted Girl ready to meet her boyfriend in Dotted Girl Sauna Flirting. Help her change into something comfortable before they head into the sauna. Use essential oils to set the mood during their time together, then choose the outfit she'll wear after the sauna.

pages.title: 2018 New Fashion Look
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create new dresses with Rachel, Ellie, and Annie in 2018 New Fashion Look. The three princesses get together at Rachel's home to try out styles for the new year. Choose how each dress will look and give the friends different outfits for their outing.

pages.title: Mastermind
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Deduce the order of the hidden colors in Mastermind. Make a guess, then use the feedback to narrow down which colors belong in the sequence and where they go. Attempts are limited, so use each new guess to test what you learned from the previous one.

pages.title: Domino Block
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Match the dots on your dominoes to the open ends in Domino Block. Look at the tiles in your hand and decide which one to put down on your turn. The goal is to play your last domino before your opponent plays theirs.

pages.title: Sudoku Express
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fill in the empty squares in Sudoku Express so every row, column, and 3-by-3 box contains the digits one through nine. Choose a difficulty, then use the numbers already in place to narrow down each blank. Select a square and enter the number when you've worked out what belongs there.

pages.title: FGP Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Find matching stones in FGP Mahjong. Look for pairs you can remove, then see which tiles become available as the layout opens up. Clear one board to move on to the next and look for combinations that leave you more choices for later moves.
